# Preetham Kyanam

> Computer engineer based in Ashburn, Virginia. B.S. Computer Engineering from Virginia Tech (2023). Works at the intersection of embedded systems, emulation, and AI agent infrastructure. IT contractor at Harrington Process Solutions (HIPCO) on internal applications and AI initiatives, and builder of independent projects under Belweave, his personal AI R&D lab. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner and AI Practitioner.

## Projects

- [Projects](https://preetham.org/projects/index.md): Things built under Belweave, plus a live feed of latest GitHub activity
- [trifecta](https://preetham.org/projects/trifecta.md): Cross-platform coding agent platform — desktop server plus native iOS/Android clients (public beta)
- [brainbase + graphbrain](https://preetham.org/projects/brainbase.md): Knowledge-graph API for AI agents, backed by a Neo4j graph database
- [ArduRoomba](https://preetham.org/projects/arduroomba.md): Arduino library that revives legacy iRobot Roombas (most-starred, covered by Hackster.io)
- [claude-ps5-mcp](https://preetham.org/projects/claude-ps5-mcp.md): MCP server that wakes PS5 consoles via Claude Code
- [gba-next](https://preetham.org/projects/gba-next.md): Game Boy Advance emulator with ARM7TDMI CPU emulation, in the browser
- [codex-ios](https://preetham.org/projects/codex-ios.md): Native iOS app for OpenAI Codex, plus a Swift SDK
- [OpenHome Abilities](https://preetham.org/projects/openhome-abilities.md): Voice AI abilities for the OpenHome smart speaker platform
- [gh-contributions-menu-bar](https://preetham.org/projects/gh-contributions-menu-bar.md): macOS menu bar app for the GitHub contribution graph
